title: Grain pill

reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Two frosted pills read one chrome ramp along a swirled coordinate at a jittered position, so the grain gathers where the ramp is steep; black type with an oval sits beside and under them.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 736 × 920 and every length scales with the canvas

angle.does: Direction the ramp runs across the upper pill, ±10 degrees by seed.

angle2.does: Direction the ramp runs across the lower pill.

run.does: How much of the ramp one pill spans end to end.

run2.does: How much of the ramp the lower pill spans; it is shorter, so it needs more to reach the pink.

bend.does: A quadratic across the run, which cups the bands into a swoosh.

swirl.does: Amplitude of the sine that bends the bands into a swoosh.

rimBands.does: Bands that follow the pill's edge inside 0.07 of its height, the thin yellow and gray stripes along the source's rims.

shift.does: Slides every pill along the ramp, which moves the dark, yellow and pink bands together.

shift2.does: Where on the ramp the lower pill starts: 0.2 opens its top corner on the light gray just before the dark swoosh.

pillH.does: Height of both pills. Measured 158 and 159 px; the ends are full half circles.

pill2.does: Length of the lower pill. Measured 226 px, 1.42 times its height.

frost.does: How much of the blurred type reads through a pill. Measured: the S of the middle line shows at about 30 % contrast under the glass.

frostBlur.does: σ of the blur on the type seen through the glass.

jitter.does: σ of the offset each pixel reads the ramp at. Measured: high-pass σ is 1.2 to 1.5 times the local slope in L per px, so the grain gathers on the band edges.

grain.does: Luminance grain on the glass where the ramp is flat. Measured 1.3 to 1.8; the ground carries none.

grainSize.does: Softening of the grain field. Measured lag-1 correlation 0.6 to 0.8 on the glass.

capH.does: Cap height of the three lines. Measured 27 to 28 px.

lead.does: Baseline to baseline. Measured 50 to 51 px.

indent.does: How far the middle line steps in from the margin. Measured 45 px.

tab.does: Where the second word of the last line starts, from the margin. Measured 135 px.

oval.does: Stroke of the oval round the middle line. 0 removes it.

seed.does: Re-rolls the swirl phase and each pill's turn of the run.

phase.does: Position along the loop. Slides both pills once along the mirrored ramp, so the bands flow and return.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Dark band to yellow: the steepest run of the ramp, where the jittered read scatters dark specks into the yellow.

techniques.name: Frost
techniques.implementation: Frosted run: light gray with the type under it blurred 3.5 px and shown at 25 %.

techniques.name: Chrome
techniques.implementation: Rim bands: stripes that follow the pill's edge inside 0.07 of its height.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: Pill edge: cut in 1.4 px, with a light line on the first 1.6 px inside.

techniques.name: Type
techniques.implementation: Type: Archivo 500, 27.5 px caps, 50.5 px from baseline to baseline.

techniques.name: Ground
techniques.implementation: Ground: flat 230 230 230; no grain reaches it.

pass_order: type on its own layer: three lines of Archivo 500 at a 27.5 px cap and a 50.5 px pitch, the middle line indented 45 px and ringed by a 2.6 px oval, the last line's second word at a 135 px tab
ground and type flat: no grain on the ground, as measured
one grain field: position-hashed noise softened 0.6 px, normalized

each pill: a stadium 158 px tall; every pixel reads the chrome ramp along a tilted run, a swirl, a cupping bend and bands that follow the rim, at a position jittered by the grain field; the type under it is blurred 3.5 px and shows at 25 %
a light line on the first 1.6 px inside each pill's edge
the tag in Archivo 400 on the glass, sharp, one word per line

measured.edge_px: 1 to 2, with a 239 light line at the top edge

grain.hp_over_slope: 1.2 to 1.5 L per (L per px): high-pass σ at 3 px blur binned by local slope over both pills

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Chrome palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The benchmark sets the type and tag to the source's wording, so the type patch and the frosted letters compare the same shapes. The pills sit where the source's do; their swirl is generated.

limits: Bench mean 0.94. The upper chrome patch scores 0.73 on its histogram and 0.82 on its dark ink: the source's swoosh is a hand-drawn C that keeps 41 % of the patch in mid gray and wraps its yellow under the rim; the render's warped run spaces its bands more evenly, so it shows more yellow and white and less gray. The lower pill's histogram scores 0.86 for the same reason.
The type patch histogram scores 0.86: 7.5 % of the source's pixels round the letters read above 240, JPEG ringing on a 230 ground; the render's ground is flat and no ringing was added.
Archivo 500 stands in for the source's grotesque; caps, pitch, indent and tab are set to the measured 27.5, 50.5, 45 and 135 px.
The copy is Mindgut wording by default; the benchmark sets the source's words so the type and frost patches compare the same shapes.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
